name: catholic-ai
description: Claude Skills from the catholic-ai repository.

plugins.name: cst-finding
plugins.description: Rates an AI use case or an audited prompt/response pair against Catholic Social Teaching.

plugins.name: catholic-privacy-and-ai-governance
plugins.description: Front door to the Catholic Privacy and AI Governance skill family; routes a generic privacy or AI-governance request to the right specialist skill.

plugins.name: draft-privacy-impact-assessment
plugins.description: Drafts a structured Data Protection/Privacy Impact Assessment (DPIA/PIA) against a pluggable registry of laws and standards and a seven-dimension privacy-by-design rubric.

plugins.name: assess-ai-system-risk-tier
plugins.description: Classifies an AI system against the EU AI Act's risk tiers and NIST AI RMF's functions, then scores it against a seven-dimension AI-governance rubric.

plugins.name: draft-privacy-notice-update
plugins.description: Drafts a proposed privacy notice or policy revision for a changed data-processing practice, grounded in a full assessment against the same rubric draft-privacy-impact-assessment uses.

plugins.name: triage-privacy-rights-request
plugins.description: Triages an incoming data-subject rights request against a pluggable registry of laws, calculates the governing response deadline, and flags outstanding gaps before a response is sent.

plugins.name: triage-privacy-incident
plugins.description: Triages a reported privacy incident against a pluggable registry of laws, scores its severity, identifies every independent notification obligation and its deadline, and flags whether it meets the threshold for escalation.

plugins.name: triage-ai-incident
plugins.description: Triages a reported AI safety, bias, or reliability incident against a pluggable registry of laws and standards, scores its severity, identifies every independent notification or reporting obligation and its deadline, and flags whether it meets the threshold for escalation.

plugins.name: review-vendor-privacy-assessment
plugins.description: Reviews a vendor's privacy questionnaire, DPA, or certifications against a fixed baseline, marks each item satisfied, partial, or missing with evidence or a gap, tracks remediation commitments, and states an overall risk level and reassessment date.

plugins.name: review-ai-vendor-governance
plugins.description: Reviews a vendor's or foundation-model provider's AI governance documentation against a fixed baseline, marks each item satisfied, partial, or missing with evidence or a gap, tracks remediation commitments, and states an overall risk level and reassessment date.

plugins.name: draft-model-card
plugins.description: Produces a model or system documentation record for an AI system, grounded in a full assessment against the current framework registry and the same seven-dimension AI-governance rubric assess-ai-system-risk-tier uses.

plugins.name: review-data-retention-entry
plugins.description: Checks one data-inventory entry against the current framework registry and its own stated review interval, producing a single verdict — current, needs review, needs an updated justification, or retire.

plugins.name: review-ai-system-reassessment
plugins.description: Checks one inventoried AI system against the current framework registry and its own defined re-evaluation interval, producing a single verdict — current, needs review, needs a documentation update, or retire.

plugins.name: map-regulatory-change
plugins.description: Given a pasted privacy regulatory or standards development, summarizes it and maps its impact against the current framework registry, recommending whether to register, update, retire, or take no action on a framework entry.

plugins.name: map-ai-regulatory-change
plugins.description: Given a pasted AI-specific regulatory or standards development, summarizes it and maps its impact against the current framework registry, recommending whether to register, update, retire, or take no action on a framework entry.
